relations.subject: Mysore Hiriyanna
relations.role: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) and Master of Arts (M.A.)
relations.evidence: He obtained his Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) and Master of Arts (M.A.) qualifications from the Madras Christian College, Madras.

relations.subject: Mysore Hiriyanna
relations.evidence: His first job was as librarian at the Mysore Oriental Library (now, the Oriental Research Institute, Mysore) which he joined in 1891.

relations.subject: Mysore Hiriyanna
relations.evidence: Upon his return to Mysore, he joined the Government Normal School as a teacher in 1896 and eventually became a Head-Master by 1907.

relations.subject: Mysore Hiriyanna
relations.evidence: Hiriyanna was appointed as Lecturer in Sanskrit at Maharaja College, Mysore in 1912.

relations.subject: Mysore Hiriyanna
relations.evidence: He was promoted to the post of Assistant Professor of Sanskrit by 1914.

relations.subject: Mysore Hiriyanna
relations.evidence: M. Hiriyanna was made Professor of Sanskrit Studies at Maharaja College, Mysore by 1919. He held Professorship for the next eight years and retired from the University of Mysore in 1927.
